verses.text: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever. ב Bet
Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever. ג Gimel
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable. ד Dalet
One generation shall praise thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts. ה He
I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, And of thy wondrous works. ו Waw
And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: And I will declare thy greatness. ז Zain
They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness. ח Het
The LORDis gracious, and full of compassion; Slow to anger, and of great mercy. ט Tet
The LORDis good to all: And his tender mercies are over all his works. י Yod
All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; And thy saints shall bless thee. כ Kaph
They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power; ל Lamed
To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glorious majesty of his kingdom. מ Mem
Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations. ס Samek
The LORD upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that be bowed down. ע Ain
The eyes of all wait upon thee; And thou givest them their meat in due season. פ Pe
Thou openest thine hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing. צ Zade
The LORDis righteous in all his ways, And holy in all his works. ק Qoph
The LORDis nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth. ר Resh
He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: He also will hear their cry, and will save them. ש Shin
The LORD preserveth all them that love him: But all the wicked will he destroy. ת Taw
My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
